text: None is answered yet; mine is close_above:high_52w_close D, the same as livermore's. I SUPPORT the name: Template passes on proxies, `subcomponents.structure.base_score` 15.0 on `subcomponents.structure.base_days` 17.0 is a formed base, `flow` 93.4 is accumulation. But W is 3.5% under the weekly high, so an hourly close above yesterday's high can print inside the base: anticipation, not the breakout (C5). ADVANCE stands for me only with the trigger moved to a daily close above the 52-week closing high, on volume (C6). That clears my objection.
